entries.name: TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY
entries.description: The client key of a TikTok for Developers app the store owns, with Login Kit and the Display API added. Not a secret on its own.
howToGet: Sign in to developers.tiktok.com and open Manage apps, then create an app for the store.
Add Login Kit and the Display API, ask only for user.info.basic, user.info.stats and video.list, and submit the app for TikTok's review.

entries.name: TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The same app's client secret. It goes only to TikTok's token endpoint, in the form body as TikTok's docs say, and keys the encryption of the stored refresh token.
howToGet: In the app's page under Manage apps, show and copy the Client secret.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: TIKTOK_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from the store's TikTok account signing in to the app and allowing only user.info.basic, user.info.stats and video.list. The connector stops if the token holds any other scope. TikTok may replace it on a refresh; the newest is kept, encrypted, in the instance's database. It lasts a year from when the account signed in.
howToGet: Sign in to the app with the store's TikTok account and allow the three permissions it asks for, nothing more.
Copy the refresh token from the sign-in's answer straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
Sign in again before the year is up and replace it.
